label: Hand off work
unavailable: Needs a session running an agent

ask.title: Ask your agent to hand off
ask.body: When the context is full or the task changes, ask your agent: "Hand this off to a new lich session." It writes a brief of what is done and what comes next, and a new session picks up from there.

successor.title: The new session sits under this one
successor.body: It opens in the same checkout and hangs under this row in the list. Click it to see the brief arrive.

delegates.title: Keep both in sight
delegates.body: Show beside lays the new session out next to this one, so you can watch it start.

close.title: Close the old one yourself
close.body: Both sessions can edit the same files until you close this one. Once the new one is going, right-click this row and pick Close session.
